scope: Append only actual webhook HTTP 400..599 numeric status to sanitized trigger message/stored detail; refresh real run state after failed Publish click.
invariants: No error.Error() read for editor-facing text.
Never expose webhook URL, headers, bodies, secrets, command paths or argv.
Transport/construction/start errors and statuses outside 400..599 keep fixed wording.
Use existing poller; stop on terminal state.

environment.bootstrap: Existing Go cache and node_modules/.svelte-kit symlinks; no install.
environment.concurrency: Root reserved single slot; fresh ps confirmed no foreign heavy suite.
environment.disk_budget: <1 GiB; df before 133445884 KiB free, after 133200000 KiB free; machine-wide readings fluctuate.

checks.command: gofmt on changed Go files; git diff --cached --check

regression_controls.command: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --project component src/lib/shell/PublishButton.svelte.test.ts --testNamePattern "un trigger rechazado"

limits: No remote webhook, provider, production, push or deployment exercised.
Svelte component mounted under jsdom; E2E and combined gate remain with root.
Both controlled mutations restored exact verified bytes; no product edits followed.
Local canonical evidence may not survive on another machine.
decision_for_shared_memory: Build-start errors retain sanitized fixed wording. Only actual WebhookRunner HTTP 400..599 responses append (HTTP N), never private response/request/Runner text. This refines previous fixed-only rule. Root owns reconciliation in Obsidian and Hebra.
